title: Repeated delivery failures and stock availability concerns
situation: Customers are reporting multiple failed delivery attempts and subsequent stock unavailability, requiring immediate logistics intervention.
hypothesis: Repeated delivery failures causing stock depletion

params.reply_en: I am sorry your delivery has been delayed multiple times. I have escalated this to our logistics team to investigate the status of your order and the stock availability immediately.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن تأخر شحنتك وتكرار محاولات التوصيل. قمت برفع طلبك لفريق الخدمات اللوجستية للتحقق من حالة الطلب وتوفر المنتج فوراً.

actions.why: Acknowledge the frustration of repeated failures and confirm escalation.

params.note: Multiple reports of repeated missed delivery appointments and subsequent stock unavailability issues.

actions.why: The issue involves recurring logistics failures that require internal investigation.
